issue.title: land.sh leaves main mid-merge after a conflicting origin sync
issue.body:
When `./scripts/land.sh` syncs local `main` with an `origin/main` that has diverged and the merge conflicts, it reports that main is unchanged, but the main checkout is left with conflict markers and `MERGE_HEAD` in place.

## Done when

- A conflicting divergence leaves no merge in progress and a clean main checkout.
- `uv run --no-sync python3 tests/test_land.py` passes.
